aboutGame.title: What is Fart Together?
paragraphs: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op party game from GamesMrkt. Two to four players occupy one shared raft and use fart power to steer it through obstacle courses filled with narrow passages, sharp turns, and moving hazards. The challenge is coordination: every input changes force, direction, and timing for the whole crew.

This wiki organizes the game's confirmed systems and early-access launch information into practical guides. Learn how to set up a crew, master shared raft control, choose the right input method, and prepare for the free demo and Steam Early Access release.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Fart Together.

items.question: What is Fart Together?
items.answer: Fart Together is a physics-based online co-op party game by GamesMrkt. Two to four players steer one shared raft with fart power through obstacle courses, coordinating direction, timing, and gas output.

items.question: How many players can play Fart Together?
items.answer: The Steam listing advertises online co-op for 2–4 players. Every player's input affects the same raft, so communication and synchronized timing are central to the experience.

items.question: Which platforms support Fart Together?
items.answer: The verified platform is Windows PC through Steam. Keyboard-only input and Xbox or PlayStation controllers are listed, while crossplay and console versions are not confirmed.

items.question: When does Fart Together launch?
items.answer: Fart Together is listed for Steam Early Access release on October 29, 2026. A free demo became available on Steam on October 8, 2026.

items.question: Does Fart Together have local co-op?
items.answer: The Steam listing advertises online co-op and does not mention split-screen or shared-screen local play. Additional courses, modes, characters, and customization are planned for the full release.
